notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are not.
REF-BM-03: Title can be edited before and after saving, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-04: Only title and tags are editable; URL, description, and note are not.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and the API returns the existing ID, but the UI does not guide the user into editing that bookmark.
REF-BM-07: The list exposes title and tags but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: The tag-entry inputs provide no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers only title and URL, not description or note.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action mechanism.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed newest-first and cannot be changed by sort key.
REF-BM-23: Markdown notes are neither stored nor rendered.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
